sources.snippet: English / 简体中文 · Launch blog 中文 · Model guide · Apache-2.0 Piccolo is a family of 4B, 9B and 27B decision models. Given a state, a question and candidate options, it returns structured decisions and candidate probabilities for tool review, context retention, data workflows and interactive environments.

sources.title: agentscope-ai/Piccolo-4B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Piccolo-4B Piccolo is a local decision model for structured judgments, including tool review and context compaction in QwenPaw. This repository contains the complete Hugging Face checkpoint of Piccolo-4B selected on October 28, 2026, including the auxiliary tensors referenced by its weight index.
